title: Post Redraw Camera Ease From Pinned Baseline
description: Post-redraw camera ease does not interpolate: fixture sync effect runs before ease and overwrites cameraBasisFixtureRef with latest fixture so from===to. Fix from source to pinned boardPlayPaneCamerasBaseline.
summary: Post-redraw ease used `from = triptych(cameraBasisFixtureRef.current)` but the `[fixture, boardRedrawPlaying]` effect runs first when play stops and sets `cameraBasisFixtureRef` to the latest fixture, so `from` and `to` were identical and only the final baseline rAF moved the camera. Ease `from` is now a shallow copy of `boardPlayPaneCamerasBaseline` (the pinned cameras shown during play). Vitest 58 passed.
